body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0133 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "WinRM host process spawning script interpreter - Behavior: WinRM host process spawning script interpreter. Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Sysmon 1 Parent wsmprovhost to powershell/cmd"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0133"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1021.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\wsmprovhost\.exe$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\winrshost\.exe$/ nocase)
    ($e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\cmd\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\powershell\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\whoami\.exe$/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
